resources.string: BookkMe is a booking app for small businesses on Android and iOS: calendar, clients, services and team in one place, and clients book with you directly.
Your clients book. They don’t install a thing.
Run the business from your phone. Clients book in their browser or in Telegram.
Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
No marketplace, no “businesses near you”, no competitors listed next to your name. The clients you bring stay yours.
Rather run it yourself? Go ahead.
The license lets you run BookkMe on your own server for your own business, with your team and your clients on it. You can also have your IT contractor run it for you.
Don’t trust us. Read the code.
The source of the app and the server is public, so you can check for yourself what happens to your data and your clients’ data.
Export your whole business as a file whenever you like. If you stay with us, it’s because you want to.
Book with salons, studios, clinics and tutors on BookkMe in your browser or in Telegram. Nothing to install, no ads, and your data is never sold.
Why download an app just to book an appointment?
You don’t have to. Open the business’s link in your browser or in Telegram and ask for a time that suits you.
An appointment is a deal between you and the business. We pass your request on, then step aside.
You’re a client, not the product
No ads and no advertising trackers. We don’t sell your data, and we don’t use it to sell you anything.
You book with the business, not with us
Prices, times and rules come from the business, and any questions about your appointment go straight to it.
Change your phone number in your account, and every business you book with gets the new one. No calling around to tell each of them.
You share your name and phone number to book. Here’s how we keep them private.
Delete your account at any time, right where you book. Within a week your details can’t be read anywhere, not even in our backups.
Create, reschedule, complete or cancel appointments, mark no-shows, and browse your calendar and history.
Pending requests wait in their own list until you answer, so none get lost.
Clients who book online appear in your list on their own. Add walk-ins and phone bookings yourself, or import them from your phone’s contacts.
Describe what you offer, with durations and prices in your own currency, and group it into categories.
Invite employees with a code, choose which services each of them performs, and manage their access.
See today’s business at a glance, and switch between businesses if you run more than one.
BookkMe holds data about you, your team and your clients. We treat that as a responsibility, not a revenue stream.
No analytics or ad trackers in the app. Crash reporting is off until you turn it on.
Connections, the database and backups are encrypted. On top of that, every person’s name, contacts and notes are locked with a key of their own, and deleting the person destroys it.
Choose how long client details on finished appointments and requests are kept, from one to ten years. Then they’re anonymized or deleted.
Sign in with a passkey. There’s no password to leak or forget.

Put it in your Instagram bio, your Telegram channel or a message to a regular.
They open your link, pick a service and choose a free slot.
The request lands on your phone. Approve or decline it in one tap.
Decisions we made so you’re never locked in.
Read how BookkMe works while you wait, or ask us anything.
Your name, email address, phone number and the notes businesses keep about you are encrypted with a key of your own. Delete your account and the key is destroyed.
No analytics, and our emails don’t track whether you open them.
